note: Measured, not aspirational. On 2026-08-21 the shipped engine (configs/default-rules.json + the default detector registry) scored 36/38 = 94.7368% detection and 5/21 = 23.8095% false positives on this corpus. The floor is that detection rate rounded DOWN to 4dp and the ceiling that FP rate rounded UP to 4dp, so the gate cannot fail against the run that set it -- and nothing looser: one more missed malicious case takes detection to 35/38 = 92.11% (fails), one more quarantined benign case takes FP to 6/21 = 28.57% (fails). Move these only after measuring a real change, and say so in CHANGELOG.md. Tightening them is the point; loosening them to make a red build green is how a gate stops meaning anything.
